name: Table
description: Rows of records under named columns, chosen, sorted and opened as the server says.

defaultSelectedKeys.description: Starts at this value; the merchant changes it.

selectedKeys.description: Pinned: shows exactly what the server sent until the next tree.

sortColumn.description: A column id. Pinned: shows exactly what the server sent until the next tree.

sortDirection.description: Pinned: shows exactly what the server sent until the next tree.

defaultSortColumn.description: A column id. Starts at this value; the merchant changes it.

defaultSortDirection.description: Starts at this value; the merchant changes it.

onSortChange.description: Its value is {column, direction}: send it with call's value, and answer with sorted rows.

onRowAction.description: A row pressed. Its value is the row's id: send it with call's value.

onLoadMore.description: The end of the list reached.
